_comment: Curated support-resource directory. The agent may offer ONLY what is in here.
Nothing in this file may be invented or guessed — not a number, not a service, not
an availability claim. If a concern has no matching row, the honest answer is that
KRYteria does not have a resource for it. An invented hotline is worse than none.
verified_at is the date a human last checked the entry against the organisation's
own published contact details. Re-verify before submission and before any release.
Figures below are as published by each organisation and were entered on 2026-11-07;
Christine should confirm each one against the organisation's site before the demo.
Emergency services are listed separately from confidential support, because they are
different things and conflating them takes a choice away from the user.

resources.name: Emergency services (911)
resources.note: For immediate danger. Call if you are in danger right now.

resources.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.note: Confidential. You do not have to call anything you are experiencing abuse to talk to them.

resources.name: RAINN National Sexual Assault Hotline
resources.note: Confidential support for sexual assault, coercion, and unwanted contact.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.note: For emotional crisis or suicidal distress. Offer only when that is what the person is describing — not as a reaction to any difficult feeling.
